'''Doronnar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] who served as the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]-based [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Moska]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Hutt [[Jolla]] plotted to engineer a dispute between Moska and Jolla's nephew [[Torga]], by arranging for the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Nomo Sliken]] to [[Death/Legends|murder]] [[Nak Simm|Torga's lieutenant]] and undermine a business deal that Torga was trying to pull off, then framing Moska as having hired Sliken. To incriminate Moska, Jolla had the [[Kitonak/Legends|Kitonak]] crime broker [[Moap]] plant some false evidence that Doronnar had sent instructions and a payment to Sliken. Around the same [[Time/Legends|time]], Doronnar visited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and while he was traveling through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] on his return trip to Nar Shaddaa, Jolla's [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] imitated Doronnar and in his guise, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] ordered some assassins to attack a group of agents that were performing an investigation for Torga, so as to further implicate Moska. On arrival back on Nar Shaddaa, Doronnar visited his mistress, then reported in to Moska.
